purpose: Define field-level mutation as an explicit semantic delta over exact target identities, distinguishing absent, unchanged, null, set, remove and replace operations.

owns: DWH Patch and Mutation Semantics semantics

topics.name: DWH Patch and Mutation Semantics
topics.purpose: Define field-level mutation as an explicit semantic delta over exact target identities, distinguishing absent, unchanged, null, set, remove and replace operations.

semantics.target_rule: Each mutation entry references exact record/resource and field identity.
semantics.absence_rule: Field absence in a patch means unchanged unless the exact patch profile explicitly defines otherwise.
semantics.null_rule: Null is a value/state distinct from absent/unchanged.
semantics.remove_rule: Field removal is explicit and schema-valid.
semantics.replace_rule: Whole-record replacement is an explicit operation/profile and never inferred from partial payload.
semantics.validation_rule: Unknown/non-writable fields hard-fail or follow an explicit extension policy.
semantics.authority_rule: Authorization may be evaluated per target/resource/field according to policy.

invariants.rule: Every DWH mutation resolves an exact destination instance/schema/record/field identity, validates intended change, evaluates authorization and conflict state, and records provenance; no write is inferred from query/display context or silently overwrites conflicting accepted state.

hard_gates.condition: partial patch treated as whole-record replace
patch target resolved by field display order

references.purpose: Patch semantics specialize exact DWH writes.
Mutation delta can be reviewed before apply.
